description: Source file implementing menu handling functions for configuration interface, including menu creation, property management, dependency processing, and display utilities.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: Represents a menu node with properties like symbols, prompts, dependencies, child menus, help text, and hierarchical relationships.

classes.name: property
classes.description: Represents a property associated with a menu or symbol, including type, expressions, and related metadata.

classes.name: expr
classes.description: Represents expressions used for dependencies, visibility, and logical operations within the menu system.

classes.name: symbol
classes.description: Represents configuration symbols with attributes like name, type, value, properties, and relationships.

methods.name: void menu_warn(struct menu * menu,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Outputs a warning message associated with a menu item.

methods.name: void prop_warn(struct property * prop,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Outputs a warning message associated with a property.

methods.name: menu_init
methods.description: Initializes the current menu context.

methods.name: void menu_add_entry(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new menu entry for a given symbol.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_add_menu(void)
methods.description: Creates a new submenu and updates context.

methods.name: void menu_end_menu(void)
methods.description: Ends the current menu scope and restores the parent menu context.

methods.name: struct:expr * rewrite_m(struct expr * e)
methods.description: Rewrites expressions involving 'm' to include module dependency.

methods.name: void menu_add_dep(struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_set_type(int type)
methods.description: Sets the type of the current menu's symbol, with warnings on redefinitions.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prop(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Creates and attaches a property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prompt(enum prop_type type,char * prompt,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a prompt property to the current menu entry, handling whitespace and upper menu visibility.

methods.name: void menu_add_visibility(struct expr * expr)
methods.description: Adds a visibility expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_expr(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a general expression property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_symbol(enum prop_type type,struct symbol * sym,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Associates a symbol with the current menu entry as a property.

methods.name: void menu_finalize(struct menu * parent)
methods.description: Performs validation, dependency propagation, and automatic submenu creation for a menu node.

methods.name: bool menu_has_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks if a menu has an associated prompt.

methods.name: bool menu_is_empty(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Determines if a menu contains visible entries.

methods.name: bool menu_is_visible(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Calculates the visibility of a menu based on its expressions and child menus.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the prompt text for a menu.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_get_parent_menu(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu.

methods.name: bool menu_has_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks if a menu has help text.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the help text associated with a menu.

methods.name: void menu_get_ext_help(struct menu * menu,struct gstr * help)
methods.description: Generates extended help information for a menu, including source location and symbol details.

methods.name: struct:gstr get_relations_str(struct symbol ** sym_arr,struct list_head * head)
methods.description: Builds a string describing relationships of symbols.

methods.name: void get_symbol_props_str(struct gstr * r,struct symbol * sym,enum prop_type tok,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Builds a string listing specific properties of a symbol.

methods.name: void get_symbol_str(struct gstr * r,struct symbol * sym,struct list_head * head)
methods.description: Generates a detailed string representation of a symbol and its properties.

methods.name: void get_def_str(struct gstr * r,struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Appends definition location info for a menu to a string.

methods.name: void get_dep_str(struct gstr * r,struct expr * expr,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Appends dependency expression info to a string.

methods.name: void _menu_init(void)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int get_jump_key_char(void)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void get_prompt_str(struct gstr * r,struct property * prop,struct list_head * head)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int menu_validate_number(struct symbol * sym,struct symbol * sym2)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void sym_check_prop(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.signature: (struct gstr * r,struct expr * expr,const char * prefix)

ctags.signature: (struct gstr * r,struct property * prop,struct list_head * head)

ctags.name: get_symbol_props_str
ctags.signature: (struct gstr * r,struct symbol * sym,enum prop_type tok,const char * prefix)

ctags.name: get_symbol_str
ctags.signature: (struct gstr * r,struct symbol * sym,struct list_head * head)

ctags.name: menu_add_expr
ctags.pattern: /^void menu_add_expr(enum prop_type type, struct expr *expr, struct expr *dep)$/
ctags.signature: (enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)

ctags.name: menu_add_prop
ctags.signature: (enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
